# Approve or decline (generated by `make strategy`)

From 2007-2014: a defaulted loan loses on average **36.5%** of the amount lent (after what was paid before the default and recoveries); a repaid loan earns on average **19.6%**. Rule: approve when (1 - PD) x gain - PD x loss > 0, with each loan's own price for the gain. Profit after Lending Club's 1 % fee, not discounted.

## The rules on 2015, counted in real money (million USD)

|                                             |   approval_rate |   bad_rate |   profit_musd |   declined_loans |   declined_bad_rate |
|:--------------------------------------------|----------------:|-----------:|--------------:|-----------------:|--------------------:|
| Approve everyone (what was funded)          |          1      |     0.1489 |        198.82 |                0 |            nan      |
| Scorecard rule (expected profit > 0)        |          0.9968 |     0.1488 |        198.47 |              913 |              0.1818 |
| Challenger rule (expected profit > 0)       |          0.9938 |     0.1481 |        198.81 |             1762 |              0.2781 |
| Challenger at the scorecard's approval rate |          0.9968 |     0.1479 |        199.38 |              913 |              0.4359 |

## With hindsight: the best approval rate for each ranking on 2015

Approving the safest x % by each model's ranking; this uses 2015 outcomes, so it is not a usable rule, only a measure of how much money each ranking could make.

|                        |   approval_rate |   profit_musd |
|:-----------------------|----------------:|--------------:|
| Scorecard              |            1    |       198.816 |
| LightGBM challenger    |            0.98 |       199.987 |
| Lending Club sub-grade |            0.99 |       199.351 |
